request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a steam ironclad: the hull becomes soot-black riveted iron #3a3835 with a light grey #8a8580 rim and a copper band; the stone castle becomes a squat iron gun turret; the red sails, masts and pennants become two tall copper #d06a2a smokestacks puffing white steam; add small bright green #2bd94a lamps. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
